nfsd_threads.description: Number of kernel nfsd threads — RPC request concurrency. Raise on busy servers (e.g. 16/32).

nfsd_port.description: nfsd listen port (2049 is the standard).

nfsd_grace_time.description: Seconds clients get to reclaim locks/state after a server restart.

nfsd_udp.description: Accept NFS over UDP (off by default; NFSv4 is TCP-only).

nfsd_rdma.description: Enable the RDMA transport (needs RDMA-capable hardware/drivers).

nfsd_rdma_port.description: RDMA listen port (used only when rdma = y).

mountd_port.description: Fixed mountd port (0 = dynamic). Pin it to open a firewall for NFSv3.

mountd_manage_gids.description: Resolve a user's supplementary groups on the server (bypasses the client's 16-group limit).

statd_port.description: Fixed statd (NSM) port (0 = dynamic). Pin it for NFSv3 firewalling.

lockd_port.description: Fixed lockd (NLM) TCP port (0 = dynamic). NFSv3 firewalling.

gssd_use_gss_proxy.description: Use gss-proxy for Kerberos (krb5/krb5i/krb5p) security flavours.
